place_rocket: Place the rocket on the orbit
tutorial_select: Look at a planet for 2 seconds, or point and confirm with your controller.
tutorial_grab: Confirm the rocket position, then aim at the gold tip and pinch-drag to set speed and angle. Controller grip-drag also works.
tutorial_thrust: Use brief boost or brake burns to get a green forecast, then coast for a full revolution.
collision: The rocket collided with a celestial body
escaped: The rocket left the mission boundary
eye_permission_hint: Enable eye tracking in Settings, or select with the controller.
overview_scale: True body size ratios · compressed spacing
trigger_up: Tap for a pulse; hold trigger to boost
trigger_down: Tap for a pulse; hold trigger to brake
forecast_coast: Engine-off forecast; thrust changes the path
arrow_hint: Pinch the gold tip: extend or shorten the arrow for speed, change its direction to aim.
lesson_place: 01 PLACE: grip and move the rocket, then release. Or confirm its current position.
lesson_grabbing: PLACING: release the grip to place. Launch requires separate confirmation.
lesson_aiming: AIMING: pinch and move to adjust speed and angle. Release does not launch.
lesson_aim: 02 AIM: point your hand ray at the gold tip, pinch and move to set launch velocity.
lesson_adjust: 02 ADJUST: make the forecast green. Challenge mode also allows risky launches.
lesson_launch: 03 LAUNCH: the forecast is safe. Confirm launch to begin.
lesson_burn: 04 CORRECT: try a short boost or brake pulse and observe the change.
lesson_correct: 04 CORRECT: use brief burns to bring the forecast back to green.
lesson_coast: 05 COAST: release the trigger and complete one stable revolution.
lesson_success: MISSION COMPLETE: one stable revolution. Keep flying or choose another planet.
collision_help: The rocket hit a body. Adjust speed or direction so the red path avoids it.
escape_help: The rocket left the boundary. Try a lower launch speed or a braking burn.
timeout_help: Time is up. Get a green forecast, then coast through one stable revolution.
hand_aim_help: Aim your hand ray at the gold tip, pinch, then move your hand.
hand_aim_fallback: Enable system hand tracking to pinch-drag, or grip-drag the tip with a controller.
